data.name: Racing League Evolution
data.detailed_description:
Get ready to shift gears in a racing experience like no other.
Racing League Evolution is a vibrant, stylized racing game that blends arcade-style thrills with a narrative-driven career mode. Drive more than 10 unique cars across beautifully crafted tracks with visuals inspired by the soothing art direction of Art of Rally. Compete in the high-stakes Racing League, face off in challenges, or jump into a quick race and feel the evolution of speed.

Coming to Steam in Q1 2026.

🏎️ About This Game

Rise. Race. Evolve.
Step into the driver's seat of Racing League Evolution, where each track tells a story, and every race fuels your legacy. From humble street beginnings to legendary circuits, immerse yourself in a world where stylized visuals meet adrenaline-pumping action.

Whether you're a casual player or a hardcore racer, there’s something here for everyone — smooth controls, stunning aesthetics, and evolving gameplay that rewards both skill and exploration.

✨ Key Features

  • 🏁 Story Mode:
    Climb the ranks of the Racing League through a story-rich campaign filled with rivalries, dramatic twists, and personal growth.

  • 🎯 Challenge Mode:
    Push your driving skills to the edge in time attacks, drift challenges, and more.

  • ⚡ Quick Race:
    Jump straight into the action with customizable conditions and your favorite car-track combo.

  • 🚗 10+ Unique Cars (and growing):
    From nimble hatchbacks to turbocharged beasts — each car has its own personality, handling, and upgrade path.

  • 🗺️ 5 Handcrafted Tracks:
    Race through sweeping landscapes, neon-lit cities, and minimalist mountain passes — all with a calming yet immersive aesthetic.

  • 🎨 Stylized Visuals:
    Inspired by Art of Rally, every environment is a work of art — no photorealism, just pure visual joy.

  • 🎮 Controller & Keyboard Support:
    Play your way with fully tuned support for gamepads or keyboard setups.

  • 📈 Regular Updates:
    More cars, tracks, and modes planned post-launch, including multiplayer and online leagues.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 280 or equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 590 or better
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
